content: संनह् €4 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To tie, bind, fasten. .²2 To wear, put on, dress. .²3 To put on (as armour), arm oneself, be accoutred; समनात्सीत्ततो सैन्यम् <ls>Bk. 15. 111</ls>, <ls n="Bk. 15.">112</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">14. 7</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">16. 4</ls>. .²4 To make oneself ready, prepare oneself (for any action) (<ab>Ātm.</ab> in this sense); युद्धाय संनह्यते <ls>Mbh.</ls>; छेत्तुं वज्रमणीञ् शिरीषकुसुमप्रान्तेन संनह्यते <ls>Bh. 2. 6</ls>.
